types.SM.gates_nonzero:
SM.gates_nonzero {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (_hn : 3 ≤ n) (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (g : ZMod n) :
  (∀ (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) (π : SM.IntervalComposition I),
      (∀ (k : Fin (π.parts - 1)),
          (π.nearSign P g k = 1 ∨ π.nearSign P g k = -1) ∧
            (π.farSign P g k = 1 ∨ π.farSign P g k = -1) ∧
              (π.farSign P g k * π.nearSign P g k = 1 ∨ π.farSign P g k * π.nearSign P g k = -1) ∧
                (-π.farSign P g k * π.nearSign P g k = 1 ∨ -π.farSign P g k * π.nearSign P g k = -1)) ∧
        (π.parts = 2 → π.ordinaryWeight P hP g = 0)) ∧
    ∀ (d h : SignType) (hd : d ≠ 0) (hh : h ≠ 0),
      SM.ordinaryGate d h hd hh = (↑d - ↑h) / 2 ∧ SM.rootGate d h hd hh = (↑d + ↑h) / 2
